test.prompt: Use the configured Notion MCP tools to fetch the configured Tasks source at {{source}}. Report its provider identity, title, URL, available structure, and whether at least one record or an honestly empty source was read. Make no changes.
test.expected_output: The configured Notion Tasks source is fetched and described without a write.
assertions: The response identifies the fetched source and URL.
The source structure or an honestly empty result is reported.

readiness.prompt: Use only read-only Notion MCP tools. Fetch the configured Tasks source at {{source}} and inspect its schema plus a bounded sample of at most 10 records. For that same bounded sample inspect page bodies for embedded meeting blocks or a 'Meeting notes and updates' section; do not run a separate Meetings query. Report structure and counts only, without quoting content or making changes.

test.prompt: Use the configured Linear MCP tools to fetch the configured Tasks source or team at {{source}}. Report its identity, URL, team, and whether at least one issue or an honestly empty source was read. Make no changes.
test.expected_output: The configured Linear Tasks source is fetched and described without a write.
assertions: The response identifies the fetched Linear source or team.
At least one issue or an honestly empty result is reported.

readiness.prompt: Use only read-only Linear MCP tools. Fetch the configured Tasks source or team at {{source}} and inspect its schema plus a bounded sample of at most 10 issues. Within that same bounded sample inspect issue descriptions or comments for meeting notes; do not run a separate Meetings query. Report structure and counts only; do not quote issue content or make changes.
